name: std::ctype<char>::classic_table
intro: Returns the classification table that matches the classification used by the minimal "C" locale.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pointer to the first element in the classification table (which is an array of size std::ctype<char>::table_size).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Default-constructed std::ctype<char> facets use this table for classification.

summary: Returns the classification table that matches the classification used by the minimal "C" locale.
